question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.

-- Let me verify the query result count and check a few edge cases
WITH partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as player_a,
        GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as player_b,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker), GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker)
),
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, 
        b.striker as player_id, 
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as individual_score
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
),
paired AS (
    SELECT 
        p.match_id,
        p.player_a,
        p.player_b,
        p.partnership_runs,
        COALESCE(is1.individual_score, 0) as score_a,
        COALESCE(is2.individual_score, 0) as score_b
    FROM partnerships p
    JOIN max_partnerships mp ON p.match_id = mp.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores is1 ON p.match_id = is1.match_id AND p.player_a = is1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores is2 ON p.match_id = is2.match_id AND p.player_b = is2.player_id
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN player_a
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN player_b
        WHEN player_a > player_b THEN player_a
        ELSE player_b
    END as player1_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN player_b
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN player_a
        WHEN player_a > player_b THEN player_b
        ELSE player_a
    END as player2_id,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN score_a
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN score_b
        ELSE GREATEST(score_a, score_b)
    END as player1_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN score_a > score_b THEN score_b
        WHEN score_a < score_b THEN score_a
        ELSE LEAST(score_a, score_b)
    END as player2_score,
    partnership_runs as partnership_score
FROM paired
ORDER BY match_id, player1_id, player2_id

-- 1. Compute partnership runs per (match, player_pair)
-- 2. Find max partnership per match
-- 3. For max partnership pairs, get individual scores of both players
-- 4. Order players within each pair: higher score = player 1, tie -> higher ID = player 1

-- Let me build this step by step.

-- Step 1: Get all partnerships with their runs
WITH partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as player_a,
        GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker) as player_b,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, LEAST(b.striker, b.non_striker), GREATEST(b.striker, b.non_striker)
),
-- Step 2: Find max partnership per match
max_partnerships AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(partnership_runs) as max_runs
    FROM partnerships
    GROUP BY match_id
),
-- Step 3: Get individual scores per match per player
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, 
        b.striker as player_id, 
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) as individual_score
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker
)
SELECT 
    p.match_id,
    p.player_a,
    p.player_b,
    p.partnership_runs,
    COALESCE(is1.individual_score, 0) as score_player_a,
    COALESCE(is2.individual_score, 0) as score_player_b
FROM partnerships p
JOIN max_partnerships mp ON p.match_id = mp.match_id AND p.partnership_runs = mp.max_runs
LEFT JOIN individual_scores is1 ON p.match_id = is1.match_id AND p.player_a = is1.player_id
LEFT JOIN individual_scores is2 ON p.match_id = is2.match_id AND p.player_b = is2.player_id
ORDER BY p.match_id, p.partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 30
